SQL:
WITH _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customer_id AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.amount_sum_partition_by_customer_id" AS "amount_sum_partition_by_customer_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum_partition_by_customer_id"
    FROM orders AS orders
    GROUP BY
      orders.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  "orders.grp",
  "orders.revenue",
  "orders.n"
FROM (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
      AND _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customer_id."amount_sum_partition_by_customer_id" > 2000
      THEN 'high'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS "orders.grp",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders.n",
    orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customer_id
    ON orders.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customer_id."customer_id"
  GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN NOT orders.customer_id IS NULL
      AND _cm_amount_sum_partition_by_customer_id."amount_sum_partition_by_customer_id" > 2000
      THEN 'high'
      ELSE 'other'
    END,
    orders.customer_id
) AS _outer
LIMIT 21

WITH __slayer_stage_per_cust AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.rev" AS "rev",
    _stage_inner."orders.n" AS "n"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.rev",
      COUNT(*) AS "orders.n"
    FROM orders AS orders
    GROUP BY
      orders.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN NOT per_cust.customer_id IS NULL AND per_cust.rev > 2000
      THEN 'high'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS "per_cust.grp",
    CAST(SUM(per_cust.rev) AS DOUBLE) AS "per_cust.revenue",
    SUM(per_cust.n) AS "per_cust.orders"
  FROM __slayer_stage_per_cust AS per_cust
  GROUP BY
    CASE
      WHEN NOT per_cust.customer_id IS NULL AND per_cust.rev > 2000
      THEN 'high'
      ELSE 'other'
    END
), _cm_per_cust__rev_sum_partition_by AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(per_cust.rev) AS "per_cust.rev_sum_partition_by"
  FROM __slayer_stage_per_cust AS per_cust
)
SELECT
  _base."per_cust.grp",
  _base."per_cust.revenue",
  _base."per_cust.orders",
  _base."per_cust.revenue" / _cm_per_cust__rev_sum_partition_by."per_cust.rev_sum_partition_by" AS "per_cust.share"
FROM _base
CROSS JOIN _cm_per_cust__rev_sum_partition_by
LIMIT 21
